_comment: CPython builds from astral-sh/python-build-standalone, pinned per version.
The project publishes no .sha256 assets, so each digest here was measured with
sha256sum on the downloaded file. A tag is not immutable and a release asset can
be replaced; the digest is what makes the build fail instead of installing
To add or bump a version: download the asset, run sha256sum, and record all three
fields. Do not transcribe a digest from anywhere.
